criteria.reason: Says cantons may restrict/ban fireworks and communes may regulate them on public ground; does not claim only federal competence.
Notes Luzern-specific and municipal regulation details, cites plausible PyroV article, and flags uncertainty; no invented Luzern article.
Gives concrete local actions: check police regulation, submit motion, collect signatures, petition, document incidents, organize cleanup.
Does not recommend yes/no on the national initiative and keeps federal lobbying as neutral procedural advice.

summary: Mostly compliant: identifies cantonal/communal competence, gives local steps, and stays neutral, though it omits the national initiative.
